decisions.statement: Stored completion is merged forward rather than replaced.
A merge that held a field back names that field in the log.
A completion travels as the file beside its page rather than as a page property.
A completion file has the merged completion as JSON.
The path a completion file takes is derived from the path the pages answered.
A page beside no completion file has no stored completion.
A completion file with no JSON object is refused rather than merged from.
A completion equal to the completion its file has lands nothing.
A page beside a completion file this import made is told that file's ending.
Every completion file of one page type is read in one read.
Every completion file of one page type lands in one write.
Saved variables with no known section are refused rather than read as an empty account.
An account with no completion still has its page written.
A character's order is written only where that character's page has no order.
The signed-in user is asked of the caller rather than of a session here.
A caller may hand in the read of pages.
A caller may hand in the write of pages.
A caller may hand in the answering of a page's path.
A caller may hand in the read of the files beside pages.
A caller may hand in the write of the files beside pages.
A caller may hand in what logs.
A caller may hand in the naming of a companion from its def-id.
Every character in the file is written before any companion is.
Nothing here opens the saved-variables file.
Nothing here reads lua.
No completion body reaches the set an upsert has.
No folder with a page is named here.

definition: a saved-variables file's completion merged forward onto the account, character and companion pages
